summary: Frontend-only test on the public web preview (390x844, app_language='de', tours done, welcome dialog accepted; test project and customer created in each fresh browser context). PASS: (1) Home '+ Termin' (home-add-appointment): with the form untouched, apt-help opens /help?section=termine directly (0 dialogs) and the 'Termine & Erinnerungen' chapter is expanded and in view. After typing a title or a note, apt-help shows the confirm 'Hilfe öffnen? … Erst speichern, dann die Hilfe öffnen.' Cancel keeps the modal open with the input intact. OK/'Hilfe öffnen' closes the modal and opens help. After going back, the form has been reset. (2) Project 'Termin planen' (project-appointment): the title is prefilled with the project name and is NOT counted as dirty, so help opens directly. After the title is edited, the confirm appears, and both cancel and accept behave correctly. (3) Basic project details: pro-locked-messung, pro-locked-flaechen, pro-locked-dach, pro-locked-doku and pro-locked-rapport render with the lock and PRO label (height 45px). Each opens pro-teaser with the correct title, 3 benefits and 'Demnächst in Aufmaßprofi Pro verfügbar.'. 'Verstanden' closes the modal. 'Mehr erfahren' opens /help?section=fotos (messung) or projekte (doku) with the chapter visible, and back returns to the project with the modal closed. (4) Home 'Team & Material' / '★ PRO – demnächst verfügbar' opens the teaser 'Mitarbeiter, Material & Maschinen'. 'Mehr erfahren' opens /help?section=rapporte. (5) /help help-version shows 'Aufmaßprofi Basic … demnächst verfügbar', and after unlock shows Pro text. (6) Pro unlock (settings-pro-unlock-open, then PROFI2024): after the in-app navigation Settings → Home → Project, the Team tile is replaced by Mitarbeiter/Material/Maschinen, all 5 locked pills disappear and the real tabs show. ISSUES: (a) MEDIUM: with Pro unlocked, a full load directly on /projects/[id] (reload or deep link) still shows all 5 locked PRO pills and 'demnächst verfügbar' teasers, and the real tabs are hidden. Cause: [id].tsx never calls loadProStatus()/updateFeatures(); only index, settings and projects/index do. (b) LOW: the appointment 'dirty' check ignores address, date and customer changes on a NEW appointment. Typing only an address and then tapping apt-help opened help without asking, and the input was lost. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

ui_bugs.issue: Pro user + full page load or deep link on /projects/<id>: Features stays at its static defaults (false), so the locked PRO pills and 'demnächst verfügbar' teasers appear even though Pro is active, and the real Messung/Flächen/Dach/Doku/Rapport tabs are hidden. Reproduced: unlock PROFI2024, then page.goto(project_url). Result: pro-locked-* count = 1 for each. Client-side navigation from Home works because index.tsx:77 calls updateFeatures().

For a new appointment, the address (and date/customer) only count as dirty when `initial` is set. Typing only an address, then tapping apt-help, opened help with no confirm and the input was lost. Also: choosing a project chip in the Home modal autofills the title, which counts as dirty (harmless false positive).

issues: ProLockedPill label #94a3b8 on #f1f5f9 has a contrast ratio of about 2.4:1, and the 'PRO' lock text is 9px white on #d97706. Both are hard to read outdoors (ProTeaser.tsx:81-83).
The locked pills sit at the very end of the horizontal tab row (x≥560 at a 390 width), so Basic users only see them after scrolling. Consider a hint or putting them earlier in the row.

action_items: In app/projects/[id].tsx, on mount call loadProStatus().then(() => { updateFeatures(); force a re-render, e.g. via a setIsPro state }) so that Pro users who deep-link or reload don't see locked PRO pills. Better: load the Pro status once in app/_layout.tsx before rendering the routes.

AppointmentFormModal dirty: also count address.trim() !== '' (when it differs from the project/customer prefill), changes to date and customerId for new appointments; ignore a title that pickProject autofilled from the selected project's name.
critical_code_review_comments: app/projects/[id].tsx is about 6137 lines and should be split into tab components.
Features is a mutable module object and screens only re-render by chance. A small Pro-status context or hook would avoid stale Pro gating across screens.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all 5 requested features pass; 1 medium deep-link Pro gating bug, 1 low dirty-check gap)

seed_data_creation: TEST_Kunde and 'TEST_Projekt Pro' created only in isolated Playwright browser contexts (localStorage), which are discarded after each run. No user data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the public URL (localhost:3000 fails with SSL). Each browser_automation run has fresh localStorage. Create a project via /projects/new: fill placeholder 'z.B. Dachsanierung Hauptstraße', then 'Kunde auswählen...', the + button at (350,127), placeholder 'Nachname', customer-save, then project-save. The web Alert polyfill maps a 2-button Alert to window.confirm (accept = action). Pro unlock: /settings, settings-pro-unlock-open, settings-pro-code-input 'PROFI2024', settings-pro-code-submit.
rca_of_issue: Pro gating on a deep link: FeatureFlags.Features starts with all false and is only changed by updateFeatures(). That function is called in index.tsx, settings/index.tsx and projects/index.tsx, but not in projects/[id].tsx or _layout. So when the app is entered directly on a project page, Features is stale even though AsyncStorage holds pro_unlocked=true.
